title: Karnaphuli Tunnel
content:
{{Short description|Tunnel in Bangladesh}} {{Infobox tunnel | name = Karnaphuli River Tunnel
কর্ণফুলী নদী সুড়ঙ্গ | image = | caption = | location = [[Chittagong]], Bangladesh | status = Completed | start = [[Chittagong Port]]/Bandar Anchal | end = [[Anwara Upazila]] | owner = [[Government of Bangladesh ]] | operator = | traffic = All types of vehicles (Except motorcycles)https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/motorcycles-three-wheelers-not-allowed-bangabandhu-tunnel-561494 | length = {{convert|3.32|km|mi}} }} '''Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Tunnel '''(or '''Karnaphuli Tunnel'''){{Cite web|date=2019-02-24|title=PM launches mining work of Karnaphuli Tunnel in Chittagong|url=https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/nation/2019/02/24/pm-launches-mining-work-of-karnaphuli-tunnel-in-chittagong|access-date=2020-08-08|website=Dhaka Tribune}} ({{lang-bn|কর্ণফুলী সুড়ঙ্গ}}){{cite news|title = Karnaphuli tunnel construction likely to begin Oct 10|url=http://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/2016/08/24/construction-karnaphuli-tunnel-likely-begin-october-10/}} is an underwater expressway tunnel in the port city of [[Chittagong]], [[Bangladesh]] under the [[Karnaphuli River|Karnaphuli river]]. The length of the entire route is {{convert|9.39|km|mi}}, with the tunnel making up {{convert|3.32|km|mi}} of the length. The tunnel diameter will be {{convert|10.80|m}}. The cost of the project is estimated at US$1.1B, of which around half is financed by the [[Exim Bank of China]].{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=18 June 2019|title=Breaking new ground: Bangladesh's first underwater tunnel|url=https://www.smec.com/newsroom/current-news/breaking-new-ground-bangladeshs-first-underwater-tunnel|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=8 August 2020|website=SMEC}}{{Cite web|last=Express|first=The Financial|title=Karnaphuli tunnel to be ready for vehicular movement by next year|url=https://www.thefinancialexpress.com.bd/economy/karnaphuli-tunnel-to-be-ready-for-vehicular-movement-by-next-year-1610979206|access-date=2021-06-18|website=The Financial Express|language=en}} The [[tunnel]] is expected to be completed in 2023 and will be the first under-river road tunnel in [[South Asia]].{{cite news |title=PM set to inaugurate Karnaphuli tunnel project Feb 24 |url=http://www.theindependentbd.com/printversion/details/187196 |access-date=5 August 2020 |work=The Independent |quote=It will be the first ever river tunnel in South Asia and we expect the construction work to be completed by 2022}}{{cite news |title=Mega projects of Bangladesh and prospective impacts in transforming the economy |url=https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/562003/World/Asia/Mega-projects-of-Bangladesh-and-prospective-impacts-in-transforming-the-economy |access-date=5 August 2020 |work=Saudigazette |date=25 March 2019 |language=English}} It is expected to improve the [[Dhaka]]—[[Chittagong]]—[[Cox's Bazar]] highway network.{{cite news |title=First ever river tunnel under Karnaphuli planned |url=http://www.thefinancialexpress-bd.com/index.php?ref=MjBfMDRfMDJfMTNfMV8yXzE2NTA3MQ== |newspaper=The Financial Express |location=Dhaka |access-date=8 April 2013}}{{cite news |title=Work on Karnaphuli tunnel to begin this FY: Minister |url=http://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/2013/jul/25/work-karnaphuli-tunnel-begin-fy-minister |newspaper=Dhaka Tribune |access-date=5 August 2013}}{{cite news |title=Karnaphuli tunnel construction to start this fiscal |url=http://www.thedailystar.net/beta2/news/karnaphuli-tunnel-construction-to-start-this-fiscal/ |newspaper=The Daily Star |access-date=5 August 2013}} A [[China|Chinese]] company, [[China Communications Construction Company]], was selected to construct it. [[Prime Minister of Bangladesh|Prime Minister]] [[Sheikh Hasina]] and [[General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party|Chinese Communist Party general secretary]] [[Xi Jinping]] inaugurated the construction site of the Karnaphuli Tunnel on 14 October 2017. On 24 February 2019, Sheikh Hasina also inaugurated the tunnel boring phase. The tunnel segments were produced in [[Zhenjiang]], China. == History == On October 14, 2016, Bangladesh Prime Minister and Chinese President Xi Jinping laid the foundation stone of the project.{{Cite web |last=জনকণ্ঠ |first=দৈনিক |title=কর্ণফুলীর তলদেশ ফুঁড়ে এগোচ্ছে বঙ্গবন্ধু টানেল অগ্রগতি ৫০ ভাগ |url=https://www.dailyjanakantha.com/national/news/470886 |access-date=2023-01-22 |website=দৈনিক জনকণ্ঠ {{!}}{{!}} Daily Janakantha |language=bn}} Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina officially inaugurated the construction of the Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Tunnel on February 24, 2019.{{Cite web |date=2023-01-02 |title=Bangabandhu Tunnel: Tolls await final approval, 95% of work complete |url=https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/2023/01/02/bangabandhu-tunnel-tolls-await-final-approval-95-of-work-complete |access-date=2023-01-22 |website=Dhaka Tribune |language=en}} == Financing == The construction of the tunnel will cost 10 thousand 374 crores.{{Cite web |last= |first= |title=Bangabandhu Tunnel toll, opening, construction and all other information 2023 |url=https://eduportalbd.com/bangabandhu-tunnel-all-info-en/ |access-date=2023-01-22 |website=EduportalBD |language=en}} In October 2016, during the visit of Chinese President Xi Jinping to Dhaka, the loan agreement for the construction of the Karnaphuli tunnel was signed. According to the agreement, Exim Bank of China is giving Tk 5 thousand 913 crore as a 20-year loan. The rest of the funding is being done by the Bangladesh government. Exim Bank's financing interest rate is 2 percent. ==See also== * [[Dhaka-Chittagong Highway]] * [[Chittagong port]] * [[List of megaprojects in Bangladesh]] * [[Sheikh Mujibur Rahman]], namesake of the tunnel * [[Belt and Road Initiative]] ==References== {{Reflist}} {{coord|22.2304|91.8044|region:BD_type:landmark|display=title}} [[Category:Tunnels in Bangladesh]] [[Category:Karnaphuli River]] [[Category:Transport in Chittagong]] {{Bangladesh-struct-stub}}
